comments.note: TimezoneTrait.hasExplicitTimezone() duplicates the lookup pattern already found in validateSyntax_check_timezone(), but the duplication is intentional — validateSyntax runs at parse-time and mutates $timezoneToken, while hasExplicitTimezone() needs to be callable at translate-time without side effects. The two methods serve distinct lifecycle roles and should remain separate.

ShowDateTranslation.php still imports Mailcode_Parser_Statement_Tokenizer_Token_StringLiteral and _Variable for the instanceof checks after the hasExplicitTimezone() refactor. The imports are justified because getTimezoneToken() returns the base Token type and the translation still branches on the concrete token subtype.
